title: MaleTheme Solo #012 · 남 V자 보디빌더·플럼 스모키·복서 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit white-washed courtyard with a pale tiled floor, an arched doorway at normal height, low stone steps and a waist-high wall, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as him, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Vietnamese man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful boy-group center idol face with neat sharp brows, a slim nose and glossy full lips, clean-shaven, deep plum smoky eyes with dark lashes, smooth warm light-tan skin, a soft amused smile, soft rose-gold hair styled in wavy, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted pearl-cluster drop, and on the other ear a large gold hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a silver small flared temple bell, a lead ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single mixed-metal anklet. Extremely long stiletto nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful man, far beyond any real person. A massive V-shaped torso: enormously broad shoulders with capped, rounded deltoids, a thick heavy chest, a deeply carved six-pack abdomen narrowing to a comparatively small waist, huge thick arms with split biceps and horseshoe triceps, wide flaring lats, and powerful thick quads and diamond calves. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing glossy red boxing gloves and a minimal red satin T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel and a thin gold-edged white waistband strap, on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his whole chest and stomach bare.
SUBJECT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme tan-brown chelsea boots with thick platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
